lines.text: What if the real barrier to success isn't money? But the mindset you've inherited?
Meet the Five Pocket Wealth System, from Think Rich, Grow Wise.
First, Owner's Equity. Fifteen percent pays you, for being the owner.
Learn and Grow, twenty percent, buys you knowledge before it buys you things.
Petty Cash, fifteen percent, for the small stuff. Guilt-free.
Reinvestment, twenty-five percent, goes back into what's already working.
And Emergency Fund, twenty-five percent, so a bad month never breaks you.
Five pockets. One system. Every rand already has a job.
Follow at trgw collectives, and get Think Rich, Grow Wise, by Melokuhle Nsizwa Mhlongo.

bgm.query: Every rand you earn has five jobs — the Five Pocket Wealth System splits it with intention.
